intro: Daiva Pranalika is the latest Telugu Christian song from 33 album by Hosanna Ministries, Adviteeyuda written, tuned & sung by Hosanna Ministries featuring Senior Pastor, Singer, song-writer, Pastor John Wesley. This song video was released on March 02, 2023 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
